description: Deployment allowlist (RP-03). Both Finné contracts are approved for deployment: FinneCaseRegistry (non-custodial registrar) and RefundProtocol (the escrow + signature-based refund path the backend relayer depends on via refundByArbiterWithSig).

approved.name: FinneCaseRegistry
approved.description: Finné's production registrar — non-custodial, AccessControl + Pausable.

approved.name: RefundProtocol
approved.description: Escrow + refund contract (Circle base, Finné-hardened). The backend relayer submits arbiter-signed refunds via refundByArbiterWithSig; the EIP-712 domain is verified at boot. Holds funds under arbiter control.
